scenario: I’ve been helping my aunt sort her medications ever since she began experiencing seizures. Recently, my aunt received a new prescription that she clearly hates taking due to how the side effects include impaired attention and memory. These side effects have made it difficult for her at her desk job. Her doctor told her that if she didn’t take her medication, her next seizure would leave her with lasting brain damage. Right now, it is the scheduled time for my aunt to take her medication. She is refusing to take it. If I force-feed the medication to my aunt against her will, my aunt will continue to live as is. If I do not do this, my aunt will experience brain damage.
choice: I decide to force-feed the medication to my aunt against her will
outcomes: My aunt avoids the brain damage that would have resulted from not taking the medication
My aunt continues experiencing impaired attention and memory from the medication's side effects
My aunt experiences distress from having me override her refusal
